claims.text: Topical Tx fails: find vessel and cauterize w silver nitrate
claims.quote: If topical treatments are unsuccessful, proceed with nasal examination to identify and cauterize the vessel with silver nitrate.

claims.text: After hemostasis: antibiotic ointment (eg, bacitracin) on cauterized area
claims.quote: After hemostasis is successful, apply antibiotic ointment (such as bacitracin) to the cauterized area.
